$comment: Drop-in template. Copy to <host-repo>/.vscode/mcp.json when pr-review-agent is cloned as a subfolder of your host repo. GitHub Copilot Chat picks this up and exposes the pr-review-agent MCP tools (#runPrReview, #getPrDiff, ...) in Agent mode. Requires the MCP server to be built first: cd pr-review-agent/mcp-server && npm install && npm run build
